Six comments

The Balkan Hills

From the excellent early Boys of the Lough album, “Live at Passim”. This is one of my favourite albums as I learnt so much from it, and has very happy memories of times and tunes past. It is a great ceilidh band favourite, and can be played as just a 3 part version, missing out the last part. Odd that it is not already on the site.

↳ Posted by niall_kenny on September 14th, 2014.

The Balkan Hills, X:2

Second setting is something like the way the tune would be played by a box and fiddle band for a Canadian Barn Dance. A 2/4 march, I’ve transcribed it here in 2/2 so as to compare with the first setting.
Not sure what pipers play for the part endings with the G#, but the Scots Guards has |f<aB>g f>ec<A|d4 d2|.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on January 24th, 2018.

The Balkan Hills, X:3

Third setting as played by Nuala Kennedy on “A Wee Selection”. Often she varies the repeats but the first time through is what is transcribed here.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on January 24th, 2018.

Re: The Balkan Hills

Dan R MacDonald recorded a great rendition of this back in the day, in a set with his own composition “The Lasses of Campbell Street.”

↳ Posted by Lonnie the Harper on January 24th, 2018.

The Balkan Hills, X:4

I like the first version, but I believe it has some timing issues, so I edited it a little and re-posted. Hope you enjoy.

↳ Posted by Paul McG on February 20th, 2024.

The Balkan Hills, X:5

Not sure where I got my setting, maybe from one of the Ceol na Fidhle books.

↳ Posted by bagpie on November 2nd, 2024.
